summary.zh-CN: 输入 URL 后，浏览器解析域名得到 IP，建立 TCP 连接，在 HTTPS 下完成 TLS 握手，再发送 HTTP 请求并接收响应。
summary.en: After a URL is entered, the browser resolves the domain to an IP, opens a TCP connection, completes a TLS handshake for HTTPS, then sends the HTTP request and receives the response.

zh-CN: 按顺序说出 DNS、TCP、TLS、HTTP 各自负责什么
在请求失败时判断更可能出在哪一层
en: Describe what DNS, TCP, TLS and HTTP each handle, in order
Decide which layer is more likely failing when a request breaks

prompt.zh-CN: 对一个 https 请求分别说明域名解析失败、连接超时、证书错误、404 各属于哪一层的问题。
prompt.en: For one https request, assign domain-resolution failure, connection timeout, certificate error and a 404 to their layers.

hint.en: Domain to DNS, connection to TCP, certificate to TLS and status codes to HTTP.

summary.zh-CN: GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE 表达操作意图，2xx/3xx/4xx/5xx 状态码表达结果类别；服务端行为要用状态码如实表达。
summary.en: GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE express intent while 2xx/3xx/4xx/5xx status codes classify results; the server must report its behavior honestly through status codes.

zh-CN: 为查询、创建、更新、删除操作选择合适的方法
根据状态码类别判断问题在客户端还是服务端
en: Pick suitable methods for read, create, update and delete
Use the status-code class to tell client errors from server errors

prompt.zh-CN: 把四个操作（取用户、创建用户、改用户、删用户）分别配上方法、成功状态码和失败状态码。
prompt.en: Map four operations (fetch, create, update, delete a user) to a method, a success status code and a failure status code.

hint.zh-CN: GET→200、POST→201、PUT/PATCH→200 或 204、DELETE→204；参数错误用 400，未认证 401，无权限 403，不存在 404。
hint.en: GET→200, POST→201, PUT/PATCH→200 or 204, DELETE→204; use 400 for bad input, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden and 404 missing.

summary.zh-CN: 头字段携带内容类型、缓存、认证、分页等元信息；Content-Type 决定如何解析响应体。
summary.en: Headers carry metadata such as content type, caching, authentication and pagination; Content-Type decides how the body is parsed.

zh-CN: 用 Accept 与 Content-Type 协商格式
解释自定义头与 CORS 的关系
en: Negotiate formats with Accept and Content-Type
Explain how custom headers relate to CORS

prompt.zh-CN: 为发送 JSON 的 POST 请求写出必须的请求头，并说明服务端返回 text/html 时客户端应如何处理。
prompt.en: Write the required headers for a JSON POST request and explain how the client should react when the server replies with text/html.

hint.zh-CN: 客户端声明 Content-Type: application/json；返回类型不是 JSON 时不要强行解析，先记录状态与响应类型。
hint.en: The client sends Content-Type: application/json; when the response is not JSON, do not force parsing and record status and content type first.

summary.zh-CN: 用名词复数的 URL 表示资源，用 HTTP 方法表示动作；路径参数定位资源，查询参数做筛选分页。
summary.en: Use plural nouns in URLs for resources and HTTP methods for actions; path parameters identify resources and query parameters filter or paginate.

zh-CN: 把动作式 URL 改写成资源式 URL
区分路径参数与查询参数的使用场景
en: Rewrite action-style URLs as resource-style URLs
Choose between path and query parameters

prompt.zh-CN: 把 /getUserList、/deleteUser、/updateUserName 三个接口改写成 REST 风格并说明各自的请求方法。
prompt.en: Rewrite /getUserList, /deleteUser and /updateUserName in REST style and state the HTTP method for each.

hint.en: GET /users, DELETE /users/{id}, PATCH /users/{id}; verbs disappear from URLs.

summary.zh-CN: JSON 用对象、数组、字符串、数字、布尔和 null 表达数据；序列化把对象转成字符串，反序列化把字符串转回对象。
summary.en: JSON expresses data with objects, arrays, strings, numbers, booleans and null; serialization turns objects into text and deserialization turns text back into objects.

zh-CN: 读写合法的 JSON 并识别常见语法错误
解释反序列化失败时为什么要保留原始响应
en: Read and write valid JSON and spot common syntax errors
Explain why the raw response must be kept when deserialization fails

prompt.zh-CN: 手写一个包含嵌套对象与数组的用户列表 JSON，并指出三处最容易写错的语法：结尾逗号、单引号、未转义引号。
prompt.en: Write a user-list JSON with nested objects and arrays, then point out three easy syntax mistakes: trailing commas, single quotes and unescaped quotes.

hint.zh-CN: JSON 只能用双引号，不允许注释和结尾逗号；解析失败时先打印原始文本。
hint.en: JSON accepts only double quotes and no comments or trailing commas; print the raw text first when parsing fails.

summary.zh-CN: Cache-Control 决定是否可缓存与新鲜度，ETag/Last-Modified 配合 If-None-Match 让服务端用 304 表示未变化。
summary.en: Cache-Control decides cacheability and freshness, while ETag/Last-Modified with If-None-Match let the server answer 304 when nothing changed.

zh-CN: 读懂 max-age、no-store、must-revalidate 的含义
用 ETag 实现条件请求并处理 304
en: Read the meaning of max-age, no-store and must-revalidate
Implement a conditional request with ETag and handle 304

prompt.zh-CN: 为一个会变化的配置接口设计缓存策略：服务端返回哪些头，客户端第二次请求发什么，命中缓存时状态码是什么。
prompt.en: Design caching for a configuration endpoint that changes: which headers the server returns, what the client sends on the second request and the status on a cache hit.

hint.zh-CN: 返回 Cache-Control: max-age=60 与 ETag；再次请求带 If-None-Match，未变化返回 304 不带响应体。
hint.en: Return Cache-Control: max-age=60 plus ETag; the next request sends If-None-Match and an unchanged resource answers 304 without a body.

summary.zh-CN: 网络请求必须设置超时；失败重试要有次数上限与指数退避，并区分可重试错误与不可重试错误。
summary.en: Network requests need timeouts; retries need a maximum count and exponential backoff, and must distinguish retryable from non-retryable errors.

zh-CN: 为请求设置连接与读取超时
用指数退避实现有上限的重试
en: Set connect and read timeouts for a request
Implement bounded retries with exponential backoff

prompt.zh-CN: 为 4xx、5xx、连接超时三类错误分别决定是否重试，并写出一段带随机抖动与上限的重试伪代码。
prompt.en: Decide whether to retry for 4xx, 5xx and connection timeouts, then write bounded retry pseudocode with jitter.

hint.zh-CN: 4xx（除 408/429）一般不重试；5xx 与超时可重试；退避时间 = 基础值 × 2^n + 随机抖动，超过上限就失败。
hint.en: Do not retry most 4xx (except 408/429); retry 5xx and timeouts; delay = base × 2^n plus jitter, failing once the cap is exceeded.

summary.zh-CN: 重复执行结果相同的操作才是幂等的；POST 创建类请求用幂等键避免重试造成重复数据。
summary.en: Only operations that produce the same result when repeated are idempotent; create-style POST requests need an idempotency key so retries do not duplicate data.

zh-CN: 判断各 HTTP 方法是否幂等
用幂等键与去重逻辑设计安全重试
en: Judge whether each HTTP method is idempotent
Design safe retries with idempotency keys and deduplication

prompt.zh-CN: 支付接口超时后客户端不知道是否成功，说明为什么不能直接重发 POST，并给出幂等键方案的步骤。
prompt.en: After a payment request times out the client cannot know whether it succeeded; explain why the POST must not simply be resent and outline an idempotency-key design.

hint.zh-CN: 客户端生成唯一幂等键随请求发送；服务端在同一键下只执行一次，重复请求返回首次结果。
hint.en: The client sends a unique idempotency key; the server executes once per key and returns the first result for repeats.

summary.zh-CN: 接口用 Authorization 头携带令牌；密钥只能放在安全配置中，不能写进代码或日志；429 表示触发限流。
summary.en: APIs carry tokens in the Authorization header; secrets belong in secure configuration, never in code or logs; 429 means the client hit a rate limit.

zh-CN: 用 Bearer 令牌调用受保护接口
说明密钥泄露的常见途径并避免
en: Call a protected API with a Bearer token
Name common ways secrets leak and avoid them

prompt.zh-CN: 检查一段把 API Key 直接写在源码里的请求代码，给出三种整改方式并说明日志中哪些字段需要脱敏。
prompt.en: Inspect request code with an API key hardcoded in source, give three fixes and list which fields must be masked in logs.

hint.zh-CN: 移到环境变量或密钥管理；不提交 .env；日志脱敏 Authorization 与 query 中的 token。
hint.en: Move it to environment variables or a secret manager, never commit .env, and mask Authorization and token query parameters in logs.

summary.zh-CN: HTTPS 用 TLS 提供加密、完整性校验与服务器身份验证；客户端必须校验证书链，不能为了方便关闭校验。
summary.en: HTTPS uses TLS for encryption, integrity and server authentication; clients must verify the certificate chain and must not disable validation for convenience.

zh-CN: 说出 TLS 握手解决的安全问题
解释证书过期与自签名证书导致的错误
en: Explain the security problems a TLS handshake solves
Explain errors caused by expired and self-signed certificates

prompt.zh-CN: 测试环境使用自签名证书，说明为什么不应把「信任所有证书」写进生产客户端，并给出两种可行做法。
prompt.en: A test environment uses a self-signed certificate; explain why a production client must not trust all certificates and give two acceptable alternatives.

hint.zh-CN: 把自签名 CA 加入受信任列表，或使用受信任证书的内部域名；关闭校验会让中间人攻击可行。
hint.en: Add the self-signed CA to the trust store or use a trusted certificate for an internal domain; disabling validation enables man-in-the-middle attacks.

summary.zh-CN: SSE 用 text/event-stream 持续推送 data 事件；客户端按行解析事件，并处理断线重连与取消。
summary.en: SSE keeps pushing data events over text/event-stream; the client parses events line by line and must handle reconnection and cancellation.

zh-CN: 解析 SSE 的 data/event/id 行格式
处理流式输出中的取消与错误事件
en: Parse the data/event/id line format of SSE
Handle cancellation and error events in a stream

prompt.zh-CN: 写一个逐块读取 SSE 的解析器骨架，说明如何拼接被拆包的多行 data，以及取消时如何停止读取。
prompt.en: Write a skeleton SSE parser that reads chunks, explain how to join multi-line data split across chunks and how to stop reading on cancellation.

hint.zh-CN: 按 \n\n 分事件、按行取 data: 前缀并拼接；用 AbortController 取消请求并释放读流。
hint.en: Split events on \n\n, collect data: lines and join them; cancel the request with an AbortController and release the reader.

summary.zh-CN: 用 curl -i、浏览器 Network 面板或应用日志获取状态行、响应头与响应体；排查必须以实际请求和响应为证据。
summary.en: Gather status lines, response headers and bodies from curl -i, the browser Network panel or app logs; debugging must rest on actual requests and responses as evidence.

zh-CN: 用 curl 复现一次带认证头的请求
从响应头和状态码定位错误来源
en: Reproduce an authenticated request with curl
Locate the source of an error from headers and status codes

prompt.zh-CN: 线上接口在应用内报错但浏览器里正常，列出至少三条需要收集的证据并说明每条能排除什么。
prompt.en: An API fails in the app but works in the browser; list at least three pieces of evidence to collect and what each rules out.

hint.zh-CN: 收集完整 URL 与方法、状态码与响应头、响应体前若干字节、是否被 CORS 预检拦截。
hint.en: Collect the full URL and method, status and response headers, the first bytes of the body and whether a CORS preflight blocked it.
